titulo: Talking avatar: studio, voice and consent
lead: A talking avatar is the most expensive step in the factory and the most sensitive: it's a person's face and voice. In this lesson you'll see how the studio fits into the pipeline and write two pieces of your own: the avatar's consent form and a gate that doesn't let any generation start without a valid consent form.
objetivo: write the consent form for your avatar and put in a gate that closes any generation without a valid consent form.

aprende.t: Whose avatar it can be: only the person's own, with a consent form
The seven fields of the consent form: person, what it authorizes, use, languages, validity, revocation and label
A gate in a script before the studio, because the engine's own is just a written rule
HeyGen's Avatar V as a dated example (Apr/2026), not as a fixed step

hero_alt: A recording corner with a cinema camera on a tripod pointed at an empty chair in front of a gray backdrop, and a consent form with illegible text on the table.

secoes.sub: Click each step. The studio only opens after the gate.

nos.detalhe: The avatar belongs to whoever appears and speaks, and no one else. No face or voice of another person, public figure or real character.
Plain text, one line per field: Pessoa, Autoriza, Uso, Idiomas, Validade, Revogação, Rótulo.
conferir-consentimento.py rejects a missing field, a label without "IA" and an expired consent form. It exits 0 only when everything matches.
portao-avatar.sh runs the checker and estimates the script's duration. If the consent form doesn't pass, it stops with code 1 and nothing moves on.
The generation itself: the avatar service's studio, through the account of whoever owns the avatar. It stays outside this course.

secoes.legenda: explicavideos and refazvideo ask for the APROVADO_HEYGEN file before start, but the code doesn't check it. The gate in this lesson is the one that really closes.

secoes.sub: Dated example: names and features change. What doesn't change is the consent form.

texto: Avatar V, introduced in Apr/2026: identity created from about 15 s of footage, separating identity from appearance; in May/2026, motion direction in natural language (research §3). It's the studio INEMA's engines use, through the subscription.
Synthesia Express-2 (Sep/2025, full body). Hedra Omnia and OmniHuman 1.5 appear in secondary sources: reported, not confirmed in an official source as of 10/19/2026.
In generators with native audio, the mouth comes out together with the speech. In avatars, the studio syncs from the audio or from the text. Generators and native audio: course 1.

It also works with no avatar at all: local voice and scenes, like the demo in lesson 3 and course 3. The AI-generated content label, image and voice rights, and the AI Act are covered in course 2, lesson 7. Here the consent form only requires that the label exists and mentions AI.

secoes.sub: Fictional example in the kit. Yours is the same, with your own details.

blocos.conteudo:
# Termo de uso de avatar e voz (exemplo fictício)
Pessoa: Ana Exemplo
Autoriza: a própria Ana, dona do canal, autoriza avatar com o rosto dela e a voz clonada dela
Uso: vídeos dos cursos gratuitos do canal dela e cortes desses vídeos
Idiomas: português, inglês e espanhol
Validade: 31/12/2027
Revogação: pedido por escrito; vídeos novos param no mesmo dia, os publicados saem em até 30 dias
Rótulo: "Avatar e voz gerados por IA com autorização de Ana Exemplo" no canto do vídeo e na descrição

abas.html:
OK: termo de Ana Exemplo · 7 campos · válido até 31/12/2027
saída: 0
FALTA: Rótulo
saída: 1

The second file is the same consent form without the Rótulo line. The field labels also work in English and Spanish (Person, Label, Etiqueta…).

secoes.sub: The script doesn't call any studio: it only decides whether you can open the studio and how many seconds you will ask for.

blocos.conteudo:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# portao-avatar.sh — porta de entrada de qualquer geração de avatar: sem termo conferido, nada segue.
# Uso: bash portao-avatar.sh <termo.md> <roteiro.txt>
# Não chama estúdio nenhum: só decide se você PODE abrir o estúdio, e quantos minutos vai pedir.
K=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)
termo="${1:?uso: portao-avatar.sh <termo.md> <roteiro.txt>}"; roteiro="${2:?falta o roteiro}"
python3 "$K/conferir-consentimento.py" "$termo" || { echo "PORTÃO FECHADO: corrija o termo antes de gerar"; exit 1; }
p=$(wc -w < "$roteiro")
echo "roteiro: $p palavras ≈ $(( (p * 60 + 139) / 140 )) s a 140 palavras/min"
echo "PORTÃO ABERTO: pode levar ao estúdio (a geração gasta crédito: confira o plano antes)"

abas.html:
OK: termo de Ana Exemplo · 7 campos · válido até 31/12/2027
roteiro: 37 palavras ≈ 16 s a 140 palavras/min
PORTÃO ABERTO: pode levar ao estúdio (a geração gasta crédito: confira o plano antes)
saída: 0
FALTA: Rótulo
PORTÃO FECHADO: corrija o termo antes de gerar
saída: 1

Put the gate call as the first line of your production script, before start: with set -e, exit code 1 stops everything.

secoes.sub: Your consent form and your gate.

exercicios.pronto: OK: termo de Ana Exemplo · 7 campos · válido até 31/12/2027 with saída: 0, and FALTA: Rótulo with saída: 1.

exercicios.texto: Write ~/meu-termo.md with the seven fields, using your own details and whatever expiration date makes sense for you.
exercicios.pronto: python3 ~/projetos/formacao-cinema-ia-fabrica-v72/kit/conferir-consentimento.py ~/meu-termo.md; echo "saída: $?" → OK: termo de [your name] · 7 campos · válido até … and saída: 0.

exercicios.texto: Run the gate with your consent form and one of your own scripts as a text file.

secoes.sub: The explanation appears after you answer.

perguntas.p: A client asks for a video with the avatar of a famous presenter. What does this lesson's consent form allow?
opcoes: Yes, if the video carries an AI label.
Yes, if it's for a free course.
Yes, if the client signs the consent form on the presenter's behalf.
No: the avatar belongs only to the person themselves, with their own consent form.
perguntas.explica: The Pessoa field is who appears and speaks, and that person is the one who authorizes. A label does not replace consent.

perguntas.p: Why put a gate in a script if the engine already asks for APROVADO_HEYGEN?
opcoes: The engine's file is not checked by the code.
Because HeyGen requires a bash script to generate.
Because the gate makes the avatar cheaper in the studio.
Because APROVADO_HEYGEN expires on its own after 24 h.
perguntas.explica: A rule that depends on someone remembering fails on a busy day. A script that exits with code 1 really closes the gate.

perguntas.p: The checker answers "VENCIDO: validade 31/12/2025". What should you do?
opcoes: Change the date in the file and go ahead with production.
Ask the person for a new consent form.
Delete the Validade line so the script doesn't look at it.
Run the studio with --force and see what happens.
perguntas.explica: The expiration date is part of what the person authorized. New consent form, signed by them, and only then does the gate open.

itens.texto: the avatar and voice belong to the person themselves, with their own consent form.
seven fields, checked by script, with a label that mentions AI.
code 1 without a valid consent form; the studio only after that.
